project.title: The Spoon That Bends
project.title_vi: Vì sao chiếc thìa trông như bị gãy trong nước?
project.subject: Refraction and apparent position at a plane water-air interface

learning_objective: Explain that a straight spoon partially submerged in water appears displaced because light from its submerged part refracts as it exits water into air, and the eye traces the refracted ray backward to an apparent image closer to the surface.
misconception: The spoon is physically bent by water.

characters.name: Nia
characters.design: Original stylized educational-film character; see shared/ART-DIRECTION.md
characters.continuity: One design, outfit, palette, body proportions and handedness for all shots

locations.description: Quiet kitchen corner at dusk, warm practical lamp, deep blue-green shadows
Stylized scientific cutaway of the water-air boundary

shots.purpose: Create curiosity with a visible contradiction

camera.start: side-on spoon and glass at waterline
camera.motivation: force attention onto the misalignment at the water surface

action: Spoon enters the glass
Submerged segment appears offset at the waterline
Nia's hand pauses
shots.visual_state: Real object remains straight; perceived submerged section is offset due to refraction

camera.start: three-quarter view of Nia and glass
camera.end: hold on straight spoon outside water
camera.motivation: show the object's unchanged physical shape

action: Nia lifts the spoon
Turns it gently to inspect
Dips it again and leans closer
shots.acting: anticipation before lift; hand/prop contact maintained; reaction after seeing the straight spoon
shots.transition_out: camera follows the spoon tip to the waterline

shots.purpose: Reveal that the path of light, not the spoon, is the cause

camera.motivation: move from the everyday scene to the invisible optical process

action: Water-air interface resolves into a clean horizontal plane
A ray travels from the submerged spoon point to the interface
The outgoing ray travels toward the observer
shots.transition_out: hold the interface as the explanatory diagram

shots.purpose: Teach the direction of refraction and the law that governs it

camera.end: slight push toward normal and angle labels
camera.motivation: make angle measurement and bending direction unmistakable

action: Show water below and air above the boundary
Draw the normal perpendicular to the interface
Reveal the incident ray in water at 40 degrees to the normal
Reveal the refracted ray in air at approximately 58.9 degrees to the normal
Reveal the labels and Snell's law after the geometry is established
on_screen_text: n_nước sin(theta_nước) = n_không khí sin(theta_không khí)
shots.transition_out: retain ray and add the backward extension

shots.purpose: Explain why the submerged segment appears closer to the surface

camera.end: frame both actual and apparent points
camera.motivation: compare true position and virtual image without losing the ray geometry

action: Continue the refracted ray toward the observer
Draw a dashed backward extension into the water
Place the apparent image point above the actual submerged point
Label both points and briefly hold for comprehension
shots.transition_out: match the diagram ray to the real spoon

camera.end: calm final close-up of the intact spoon
camera.motivation: connect the invisible diagram to the everyday observation

action: Nia looks from the ray diagram back to the glass
Lifts the spoon and confirms it is straight
A gentle match cut resolves the apparent kink
shots.acting: confusion settles into recognition; restrained, not comedic overacting

narration_spans.text: Nhìn này. Chiếc thìa trông như bị gãy ngay tại mặt nước.
Nhưng khi kéo nó ra, chiếc thìa vẫn thẳng. Nước không hề bẻ cong kim loại. Vậy điều gì đã thay đổi?
Ánh sáng từ phần thìa chìm dưới nước phải đi qua ranh giới giữa nước và không khí trước khi tới mắt chúng ta.
Khi đi từ nước sang không khí, ánh sáng đổi hướng và lệch ra xa pháp tuyến. Đó là hiện tượng khúc xạ. Góc tới và góc khúc xạ tuân theo định luật Snell.

Mắt không biết tia sáng đã đổi hướng. Nó kéo dài tia sáng ngược lại theo một đường thẳng, nên phần thìa chìm dường như nằm cao hơn vị trí thật. Vì vậy, hai phần của chiếc thìa có vẻ không còn thẳng hàng.
Chiếc thìa chưa từng bị gãy. Chính ánh sáng đã đổi hướng trên đường đi tới mắt chúng ta.

audio_cues.description: light metallic lift; small intentional pause
subtle airy transition into optical cutaway
single soft tick as normal and angle labels appear
soft tonal pop as apparent image point appears
quiet resolved ending with 0.5 second visual hold
